title: Rows for the 3-band compressor (CMP1)
author: naturarum
description: EXPERIMENT: emulator-tested only (0.1 ran on a unit in GT01). Adds 17 parameter rows, through param-grow, for the 3-band master compressor: per band (LOW, MID, HIGH) threshold, ratio, attack, release and makeup, and two crossovers. 0.2 gives them their names, ranges (ratio 0..8: 1.00 = band off, then the 8 stock ratios), new-kit defaults (the stock compressor's) and value texts (dB, Hz/kHz); comp-ui-dn2 puts them on the MIXER view's band pages. They stay in FX slots 70..86 that no stock row uses and the stock storage does not keep, never p-lockable, with no MIDI CC or NRPN and no randomiser. Data only: the stock image is not changed. For dn2-cfw's CMP1 build.
